Description: No Backup Vaults were found. Vaults are used to save and organize backups, and are required for all backup plans and backup jobs.
Risk: Without backup vaults, no plans and recovery points can be set up in AWS Backup.

Recommendation.Text: Create backup vaults in all affected regions before configuring backup plans. When using AWS Backup through the AWS CLI, AWS SDK, or CloudFormation, a custom vault is required.
